en.title: Mobile Application Developer
description: Developed and maintained Flutter-based mobile apps including Side Hustle, AcademIQ, and Diecarz, spanning gamified rewards, AI-driven education, and social platforms.
Implemented secure, multi-platform authentication (Apple Sign-In, Google OAuth) and integrated tracking/analytics SDKs (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust).
Built AI-powered conversational features in AcademIQ using ChatGPT APIs, including structured outputs, custom chat modes, and offline support via Isar DB.
Delivered responsive UI, scalable Firebase integrations, and collaborated across sprints to ensure clean architecture and timely feature rollouts.
shortDescription: Developed and launched three cross platform Flutter apps (Side Hustle, AcademIQ, Diecarz) from concept to production, spanning gamified rewards, AI education, and social collection platforms.
Architected secure authentication systems (Apple/Google Sign-In), AI conversational features with ChatGPT/Gemini APIs, and analytics integrations (Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Adjust) across all products.
Delivered scalable Firebase architectures with offline first support (Isar DB), responsive UI, and clean state management (Riverpod) while collaborating in remote agile sprints.

de.title: Mobile-App-Entwickler
description: Entwicklung und Wartung Flutter-basierter Mobile-Apps, darunter Side Hustle, AcademIQ und Diecarz, von gamifizierten Belohnungen über KI-gestützte Bildung bis zu sozialen Plattformen.
Implementierung sicherer, plattformübergreifender Authentifizierung (Apple Sign-In, Google OAuth) und Integration von Tracking- und Analytics-SDKs (Singular, AppsFlyer, Adjust).
Entwicklung KI-gestützter Konversationsfunktionen in AcademIQ mit ChatGPT-APIs, einschließlich Structured Outputs, eigener Chat-Modi und Offline-Unterstützung über Isar DB.
Umsetzung responsiver UIs und skalierbarer Firebase-Integrationen sowie Zusammenarbeit über Sprints hinweg für eine saubere Architektur und termingerechte Feature-Releases.
shortDescription: Entwicklung und Launch von drei plattformübergreifenden Flutter-Apps (Side Hustle, AcademIQ, Diecarz) vom Konzept bis zur Produktion, von gamifizierten Belohnungen über KI-Bildung bis zu sozialen Sammlerplattformen.
Konzeption sicherer Authentifizierungssysteme (Apple/Google Sign-In), KI-Konversationsfunktionen mit ChatGPT/Gemini-APIs und Analytics-Integrationen (Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Adjust) für alle Produkte.
Umsetzung skalierbarer Firebase-Architekturen mit Offline-First-Unterstützung (Isar DB), responsiver UI und sauberem State Management (Riverpod) in Remote-Teams mit agilen Sprints.

en.title: Software Engineer
description: Built AskWillow end to end as the sole developer: an AI quoting assistant for landscapers in Flutter (Android, iOS and web with desktop and mobile layouts) on Supabase, with tool-calling AI chat (Gemini/OpenAI), voice mode via Google Cloud Text-to-Speech and configurable proposal PDFs.

Built a full stack B2B Sales Quotation System (React, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core 8, SQL Server) integrating Enapps ERP, KREO AI and WooCommerce, with a rule based pricing engine, JWT authentication, role based access and audit logging.
Migrated AI Planner from Claude 3.5/3.7 to OpenAI (GPT-4.1) with structured outputs, parallel function calling and dynamic model switching, cutting response latency by 50%+.
Extended the Caregiver Management App with recurring task scheduling, media attachments, 9 language localization (including RTL) and push notification fixes.
Maintained production apps and business automation integrations with Monday.com, Sitelink and Aircall, refactoring state management and resolving core logic issues.
shortDescription: Built AskWillow solo, an AI quoting assistant for landscapers on Android, iOS and web (Flutter, Supabase) with tool-calling AI chat, voice mode and configurable proposal PDFs.
Built a full stack B2B Sales Quotation System (React, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server) integrating Enapps ERP, KREO AI and WooCommerce.

Led the AI Planner migration from Claude to OpenAI with structured outputs and parallel function calling, cutting latency by 50%+, and maintained production apps and integrations (Monday.com, Sitelink, Aircall).
